headline: Russians destroying Ukraine's economy: dozens of warehouses damaged by attacks
summary: Since the start of 2026, Russia has attacked Ukrainian warehouses 25 times, damaging more than 500,000 square metres of warehouse space, according to the report.
why: Warehouses are core logistics infrastructure, so damage to them disrupts supply chains, inventories and trade flows.
